🧱✨ PLAY. BUILD. LEARN. GROW. ✨🧱

Our LEGO Junior Programme is back at Club Loka, Chanakyapuri! 🌈

Designed for little builders 1.5 years+, each session combines hands-on LEGO play with exciting learning themes—from patterns, stories and numbers to colours, emotions, balance, pulleys and transport! 🚗🔢🎨

✨ Building creativity
✨ Encouraging problem-solving
✨ Strengthening fine motor skills
✨ Growing confidence through play

📅 Starts 28th September
🗓️ Monday & Thursday
⏰ 4:00 PM – 5:00 PM
👧🏻 Age: 1.5+ years

📞 For bookings: 9876540430
✨ Limited spots available!

📚✨ RAISING A READER – PHONICS PROGRAMME ✨📚

Dear Parents,

We are excited to announce a new batch of our Raising a Reader – Phonics Programme at Club Loka, Chanakyapuri! 🌟

Our engaging, small-group sessions focus on building strong foundations in phonics, sound recognition, blending and early reading skills in a fun and encouraging environment. 🔤📖

📅 Starts: 29th September
🗓️ Days: Tuesday & Thursday
⏰ Time: 4:00 PM – 5:00 PM
📍 Venue: Club Loka, Chanakyapuri

✨ Limited spots available.

📞 For bookings & enrolment: 9876540430

Warning: reading might become a habit. 📚 

Make reading their favourite kind of play. 🖊️
